rules.read_only: Inputs opened read_only=True, data_only=False; original XLSX files are never saved or changed.
rules.formal_batches: Only choice_events_*.xlsx are formal batches. choice_probe_*.xlsx test exports remain in raw and are listed as ignored; they do not enter counts, date coverage or duplicate checks.
rules.data_rows: Rows after financing-event headers, excluding empty rows, repeated headers and 数据来源 footer.
rules.missing_amount: Blank/explicit missing markers remain missing; numeric zero is recorded separately. No monetary aggregation or currency conversion.
rules.row_count: Compared only with supplied UI counts. Matching a UI count establishes export completeness for that query, not market coverage.
rules.expectation_manifest: ui_expected_counts.json accepts filename: count, or filename: {expected_count,date_from,date_to,region_filter,notes}. Counts are recorded from the UI, never replaced by file counts.
rules.names: Legal-entity words are only name-format hints; investor lists may mix brands, people and legal funds. Flagged 等/ellipsis rows require detail review.
rules.geography: Preserve original region labels. Province labels do not establish a prefecture-city match; Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan are counted separately.
rules.scope: All raw rounds retained; IPO/listing, acquisitions and transfers remain separate source categories. No government/private classification inferred from labels alone.
rules.duplicates: Exact content excludes export row number. Candidate duplicates are reported, not deleted.
rules.incremental: --file reads only selected XLSX batches, retains earlier audits, and compares duplicates within this run. Run once without --file for a final all-file duplicate check.
rules.query_intervals: Registered UI query dates are checked against every calendar day from 2012-01-01 through 2024-12-31. Gaps during download are reported; --final-check requires complete, disjoint coverage.
rules.hashes: Re-read batches are compared with SHA-256 recorded in the preceding audit. Final check reads all raw batches and requires matching prior hashes, UI counts, explicit intervals and stable inputs.
